propositions: Comment identity must derive from a persistent HLC-timestamp-keyed map to Jira comment IDs rather than normalized body equality to prevent collisions and handle edited comments correctly
The Jira comment ID returned by add_comment must be captured at both creation and update enactment sites and persisted immediately (write-ahead) against the local comment key in binding_store
Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-before-encode ordering; the dedup key must use the real codec not the identity codec

Inbound-origin jira_comment_id and outbound-mapped comments must use separate authoritative stores per direction with primary skip on either mapped key or jira_comment_id present, body equality demoted to secondary fallback
Comment sync must remain strictly append-only in both directions with no edit or delete operations pushed to or applied from Jira
Repeated reconcile passes must not create duplicate comments and crash-durability must hold even if map writes fail between add_comment and binding_store save
